slice_1.name: EVIDENCE CONTRACT AND WRITE-PATH PRIVACY BOUNDARY

mode_gates.note: The memory-adapter mode waits for PKG-05 and PKG-09 only. This mode gate is not a package-level edge.

packages.name: Evidence contract and write-path privacy boundary
packages.customer_problem: Records crossing the persistence boundary can carry secrets or unlabeled origins, and Node and Python JSON writers disagree.
packages.scope: Shared testable contract for current JSON records: allowlist, denylist, origin, issue location, status tokens, destination sanitization, session id, trace context, structural redaction, privacy results, rejection behavior, completeness impact, conformance fixtures, privacy corpus, fail-open contract API, current-reader compatibility.
packages.non_scope: SQLite, binding, schema, WAL, migration, import execution, retention, trends, alerting, UI, daemon, OTLP, SIEM, stable schema, public API, new telemetry, cost fields, encryption, hostname, LEGACY_UNMARKED promotion, seventh annotation origin, freshness CURRENT, numeric targets, wiring into CLI 0.3.24 or Python 3.1.0 imports.
packages.compatibility_risk: Current readers must keep parsing today's files.
packages.rollback: Remove the private package. Legacy JSON stays.
packages.release_boundary: RU-S1 private package. Not a CLI or Python release.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: UNIT_PROVED for the library; INTEGRATION_PROVED after writer cutover; STRANGER_HOST_PROVED and PROVED_EXTERNAL before the claim.

packages.name: Shared record vocabulary and Node/Python conformance
packages.customer_problem: Node and Python persist different envelopes for the same run.
packages.scope: Future writers emit the PKG-01 catalog. Shared fixtures gate both languages.
packages.non_scope: SQLite, CLI 0.3.24 patch, Python 3.0.15, OTLP export, stable v1, schema generator.
packages.rollback: Previous writer. Dual-read. Unknown fields are not success.
packages.release_boundary: RU-VOCAB staged. Conformance evidence for a paired claim ships together.

packages.name: Optics self-health and diagnostic event model
packages.customer_problem: Optics failures can be mistaken for customer or provider failures, and diagnostic writes can recurse.
packages.scope: product_health record and A5 diagnostic names, recursion stop, separation from customer activity.
packages.non_scope: vantio doctor, support bundle, UI, numeric targets, alerting.
later_files: health-record builder beside the contract package
packages.compatibility_risk: Missing health later means unknown drop state, which is not query COMPLETE.
packages.rollback: Stop writing health records. Observation files remain.
packages.release_boundary: RU-HEALTH before diagnostic commands and before default store path.

packages.name: Portable proof canonicalization and verifier
packages.customer_problem: Today's proof is a rendering. A byte-stable local export is specified and not built.
packages.scope: OPTICS_CANONICAL_JSON version 1 for proof.json and manifest.json, golden vector, allowlist, completeness copy, annotation exclusion by default.
packages.non_scope: Attestation language, OTLP, HTML or Markdown inside the hash, rewriting proofs during compaction.
packages.compatibility_risk: Existing proofs must verify or fail closed without reserialization.
packages.rollback: Keep proof files. Failed verification is not a pass.
packages.release_boundary: RU-PROOF library after PKG-01 and before preservation claims.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: UNIT_PROVED on the vector, then INTEGRATION_PROVED for both languages

packages.name: Operational-store interface and in-memory/reference adapter
packages.customer_problem: Search, tail, and diff scan every JSON file. The application API must exist before a binding is chosen.
packages.scope: Application-owned put/get/query interface and an in-memory adapter. No caller SQL.
packages.non_scope: Node binding selection, store.sqlite, WAL, migrations, raw SQL API, DuckDB, daemon.
packages.compatibility_risk: Interface shape becomes the PKG-07 surface.
packages.rollback: Delete the adapter. No customer files change.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: UNIT_PROVED. External store claims wait for PKG-07.
packages.note: OF-01 closes at PKG-07. This package is the interface half.

packages.name: SQLite binding evaluation and selection
packages.customer_problem: Node has no stdlib SQLite. Python stdlib sqlite3 is the expected mechanism and is not implemented.
packages.scope: A later Founder force selects a Node binding against the PKG-05 interface. This plan does not list candidates or add a dependency.
packages.non_scope: Adding a dependency, creating a database, schema, benchmarks, encryption.
later_files: Founder decision record in a later force
packages.release_boundary: RU-BINDING ships together with PKG-07 after selection.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: STRANGER_HOST_PROVED load matrix before the binding is called shippable

packages.name: SQLite schema and transactional persistence
packages.customer_problem: Per-run JSON is the current index and does not provide transactional crash behavior.
packages.scope: Application-owned schema, WAL, user_version, privacy_generation, external recovery envelope, owner-only create, symlink confinement, no raw SQL API, no empty replacement of a corrupt file.
packages.non_scope: Legacy import, retention commands, binding shopping, encryption, invented Windows ACLs, numeric page size, stable public schema.
later_files: schema and open/write/recover modules called by a future CLI and future Python
packages.compatibility_risk: First writer assigns versions later writers must honor. Legacy JSON is kept.
packages.rollback: No down-migration. Legacy JSON remains. Corrupt bytes stay. Unknown fields are not success.
packages.release_boundary: RU-STORE together with the selected binding and PKG-12.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: INTEGRATION_PROVED on one file from both languages, then STRANGER_HOST_PROVED
gates: independent council on the implementation tip
packages.note: File-backed query in PKG-10 waits for this package. The memory-adapter query does not. That wait is a mode gate, not a package-level edge.

packages.name: Legacy JSON compatibility and migration tooling
packages.customer_problem: Customers already have per-run JSON. Ignoring it hides evidence. Copying on first open would surprise them.
packages.scope: Dual-read adapter plus explicit copy that keeps originals. VANTIO_HOME for future readers. Origin rules. Corrupt JSON counted and skipped.
packages.non_scope: Copy on first open, promote to LOCAL_OBSERVATION, deletion of originals, reusing legacy schema_version 2 as user_version, patching CLI 0.3.24.
later_files: read-only adapter and explicit migrate command in a future CLI
packages.compatibility_risk: A bad mapper can persist a secret or launder origin.
packages.rollback: Originals remain. Failed copy rolls back the transaction. No down-migration.

packages.name: Correlation identity and child-process propagation
packages.customer_problem: Today's trace_id is a process-run id. Child processes and inherited context can be miscounted.
packages.scope: session_id, run_id, trace_id, span_id, producer_id, producer_sequence, event_id encoding, asserted trace context, explicit parent run, conflict visibility, baggage dropped.
packages.non_scope: Timestamp parenthood, time-window dedup while NOT_SET, synthetic LOCAL_OBSERVATION for unobserved children, SQLite.
later_files: future CLI wrapper and future Python process wrap
packages.compatibility_risk: High-cardinality ids stay off metric labels.
packages.rollback: Old files keep one trace_id mapped to legacy run_id. Missing parent stays null.
packages.release_boundary: RU-CORRELATION after PKG-02. Session-aware queries wait for PKG-10.

packages.name: Bounded query contract and query engine
packages.customer_problem: Search is an unbounded substring scan. Completeness, drops, and integrity are not one answer.
packages.scope: A4 request and response envelope, limits, two sorts, opaque cursor, exact predicates, cardinality, completeness of declared scope, default origin LOCAL_OBSERVATION.
packages.non_scope: Arbitrary SQL, caller regular expressions, body filters, UI, trend commands, freshness CURRENT.
later_files: query module and a future CLI command
packages.rollback: Disable the command. An answer without completeness is not rendered as COMPLETE.
packages.release_boundary: RU-QUERY. Memory adapter can precede the file. Customer command waits for the file.
packages.note: File-backed engine also waits for PKG-07.

packages.name: Retention, pruning, deletion, backup, and restoration
packages.customer_problem: A future limit must not silently delete evidence or rewrite exported proofs.
packages.scope: Default unbounded retention, dry-run manifest, second explicit delete step, explicit restore onto a new store id.
packages.non_scope: vantio prune in this plan, compliance claims, deletion to free space, encryption.
packages.compatibility_risk: Manifests must not list payloads. Salvage is not COMPLETE.
packages.rollback: Completed deletes are not guessed back. Failed restore leaves original bytes.
packages.release_boundary: RU-RETENTION optional. Default install stays unbounded.

packages.name: Fail-open, overload, crash, and recovery behavior
packages.customer_problem: Observation must not fail, hang, or rewrite the application call, and must not invent a successful observation.
packages.scope: A5 fail-open invariant, explicit drops, default UNSAMPLED, queue-full without deleting history, lifecycle, clock quality, crash labels.
packages.non_scope: Numeric budgets, sampling policies, enforcement actions, invented timeouts, alerting.
later_files: runtime guards in a future CLI and future Python writer
packages.compatibility_risk: Missing flush is not relabeled COMPLETE.
packages.rollback: Revert to today's exit write. Recovery envelopes stay. They are not deleted to look healthy.
packages.release_boundary: RU-FAILOPEN ships with the default SQLite writer. Slice 1 covers the contract-API subset.
packages.evidence_required_before_external_claim: INTEGRATION_PROVED including crash and fail-open, then STRANGER_HOST_PROVED
gates: S1-G7 covers only the contract-API subset

packages.name: Coverage transparency and future diagnostic command surface
packages.customer_problem: Unsupported clients and coverage gaps can be read as quiet success.
packages.scope: Future coverage status using existing tokens and product-health. Deferred CLI chrome stays deferred.
packages.non_scope: vantio doctor, NO_COLOR, shell completion, status legend, pager, quiet mode, generated help, example repository, public doc rewrite.
fixtures: unsupported client is COVERAGE or UNKNOWN and NOT_OBSERVED
packages.compatibility_risk: Customer-output if a command is added. Read-only.
packages.rollback: Remove the command. Stored evidence stays.
packages.release_boundary: RU-COVERAGE independently after self-health. Deferred items stay out.

packages.name: Local read-only UI foundation
packages.customer_problem: A local read-only view is a roadmap target. The charter is not opened.
packages.scope: After decision 13: loopback, no third-party assets, no mutation API, no daemon, PKG-10 envelope, incomplete states shown as incomplete.
packages.non_scope: Any UI file in this plan, account login, hosted dashboard.
fixtures: partial envelope not shown as success
packages.rollback: Stop the process. No data half.
packages.release_boundary: RU-UI own release after the charter.
packages.note: OF-30 exemplars wait on a UI drill-down. Trend indicators in PKG-15 do not wait on the UI charter.

packages.name: Trends, baselines, indicators, and exemplars
packages.customer_problem: Cross-run comparison is a two-file diff. Indicators are easy to confuse with SLOs and with demo or legacy rows.
packages.scope: Structural indicators, default trend exclusions, completeness carried from the source, no SLO until a customer sets a target and a window.
packages.non_scope: Topology surface, customer-configured objectives, alerting, numeric SLO targets.
later_files: future trend command after the query engine
fixtures: session_id rejected as a metric label
packages.compatibility_risk: Wrong origin filter inflates customer activity.
packages.rollback: Disable the command. Missing origin is not treated as LOCAL_OBSERVATION.
packages.release_boundary: RU-TREND after query. SLO configuration is not in this release.

packages.name: Future alerting architecture implementation
packages.customer_problem: Alert delivery mode is unselected. A daemon would contradict fail-open.
packages.scope: After decision 3, only the selected mode, fed by indicators and completeness.
packages.non_scope: Any alerter, daemon, or webhook in this plan. Incident workflow is deferred.
fixtures: Optics failure does not fail the application exit
packages.compatibility_risk: Alert body must not copy a prohibited payload.
packages.rollback: Disable the emitter. Evidence rows stay.

packages.name: Future interoperability and export implementation
packages.customer_problem: OTLP or SIEM export is requested by the roadmap and left unauthorized. Portable proof is the specified export.
packages.scope: After decision 12, only the exporter the Founder names, using the PKG-01 denylist and copied completeness.
packages.non_scope: OTLP, SIEM, webhooks, and any network export in this plan.
fixtures: prohibited canary absent from exported bytes
packages.compatibility_risk: Export can leave the machine. It does not exist in this plan.
packages.rollback: Disable the exporter. Proof files stay. A denied payload is not sent after rollback.
packages.note: OF-43 closes in PKG-04. This package is the blocked network-export successor.

requirements.title: Local operational store distinct from JSON proof
requirements.notes: Closes the local store. Interface is PKG-05. Binding is decision 9.

requirements.title: Retention and pruning without silent deletion
requirements.notes: Default unbounded. Dry-run manifest. Commands not created here.

requirements.title: Session grouping distinct from a call trace id
requirements.notes: Session grouping distinct from trace id. Slice 1 validates the field. Propagation is this package.

requirements.title: Cross-run trend command
requirements.notes: Default scope excludes LEGACY_UNMARKED, demo, fixture, and imported origins.

requirements.title: Usage and cost metadata
requirements.notes: Not on the allowlist. No body inspection. Safe default is exclusion.

requirements.title: Local read-only web UI
requirements.notes: UI not designed as a build. Charter is decision 13.

requirements.title: NO_COLOR support
requirements.notes: Inventory shows no NO_COLOR handling. Out of the foundation critical path.

requirements.title: Shell completion
requirements.notes: Architecture note: out of this foundation implementation scope.

requirements.title: Status legend command
requirements.notes: Architecture note: out of this foundation implementation scope.

requirements.title: Pager awareness
requirements.notes: Pager not present on tail or search. No contract in this pack.

requirements.title: Quiet mode distinct from JSON
requirements.notes: Not specified as a command in the architecture pack.

requirements.title: Coverage status command
requirements.notes: Coverage command waits on self-health. It is not created here.

requirements.title: Metadata redaction release-blocking suite
requirements.notes: Release-blocking suite is specified. Slice 1 builds it against the contract function. Live CLI stays PARTIAL until a later writer cutover.

requirements.title: Fail-open reliability
requirements.notes: Slice 1 covers the contract-API subset only. Closing package is PKG-12. Numeric target stays NOT_SET.

requirements.title: Versioned config file
requirements.notes: Config-file schema is not fully specified. Limits stay unset, which means unbounded.

requirements.title: Flag and schema deprecation policy
requirements.notes: No stable schema, so no deprecation schedule is opened.

requirements.title: Generated help reference
requirements.notes: Not produced by the architecture force and not scheduled here.

requirements.title: Runnable multi-agent example repository
requirements.notes: Not produced by the architecture force and not scheduled here.

requirements.title: Signal contract
requirements.notes: Structural metadata only. Prompts, bodies, and OTLP content attributes stay excluded.

requirements.title: Semantic-convention conformance
requirements.notes: No OTLP export. schema_status stays unstable-pre-1.0. Trace id is not the run id in the target model.

requirements.title: Context-propagation security
requirements.notes: Baggage prohibited. Size limits and conflict behavior are specified. Slice 1 validates. This package propagates.

requirements.title: Resource identity
requirements.notes: Process and runtime allowed. Machine hostname and username stay off the allowlist.

requirements.title: Observed dependency topology
requirements.notes: No ownership inference. A topology surface is not specified.

requirements.title: Baselines
requirements.notes: Excludes non-local origins. Structural fields only.

requirements.title: Deduplication and idempotency
requirements.notes: event_id is producer_id plus producer_sequence. Identical replay does not inflate counts. Time window stays NOT_SET.

requirements.title: Instrumentation conflicts
requirements.notes: Duplicate insert does not inflate counts. Fail-open closure waits on PKG-01, PKG-03, and PKG-05. Fixtures that need event_id also use PKG-09 once that package exists. Coexistence tests are specified and not run.

requirements.title: Data-quality dimensions
requirements.notes: Query envelope carries freshness, completeness, completenessReasons, and integrityState. CURRENT stays unemitted.

requirements.title: Golden signals
requirements.notes: Indicators only. Separate from product-health. Not SLOs.

requirements.title: Cardinality-safe metric model
requirements.notes: High-cardinality ids stay on events. They are not metric labels.

requirements.title: Exemplars
requirements.notes: Drill-down depends on a UI charter that is not opened.

requirements.title: Sampling correction
requirements.notes: Default UNSAMPLED. Sampling is not introduced.

requirements.title: Performance budgets
requirements.notes: Every numeric target is NOT_SET. This plan does not set one.

requirements.title: Graceful degradation
requirements.notes: dropState and completeness are on every default answer. Known drops in scope are PARTIAL. Application continues.

requirements.title: Crash consistency
requirements.notes: External recovery envelope. STOPPED_PRESERVED first. Salvage is never COMPLETE.

requirements.title: Local security
requirements.notes: Owner-only modes and symlink confinement. Windows ACL detail is decision 8.

requirements.title: Local UI security
requirements.notes: Loopback, no third-party assets, no mutation API, no daemon. UI itself waits on decision 13.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.notes: Accessibility is not designed. Charter is decision 13.

requirements.title: Destination normalization
requirements.notes: Case, explicit ports, query stripped, no redirect rewrite.

requirements.title: Provider identity confidence
requirements.notes: Catalog, regional pattern, local Ollama, or unknown. Writer cutover is PKG-02. Slice 1 locks the rule and fixtures.

requirements.title: Privacy corpus
requirements.notes: Corpus scope is specified in the Slice 1 spec. Tests are not implemented by this planning PR.

requirements.title: Local data operations
requirements.notes: Selective delete only via manifest. No compliance claims.

requirements.title: Automation contract
requirements.notes: Bounded query is the read contract. Local only.

requirements.title: Export formats
requirements.notes: Proof profile only. OTLP stays unauthorized under decision 12 and PKG-17.

requirements.title: Incident workflow
requirements.notes: Incident workflow is not specified.

requirements.title: Alert lifecycle
requirements.notes: Delivery mode not selected. No daemon.

requirements.title: SLI/SLO separation
requirements.notes: No SLO until a customer sets a target and a window. This plan does not create that configuration.

requirements.title: Cross-platform matrix
requirements.notes: Matrix is not executed. Windows ACL specifics remain decision 8.

requirements.title: Upgrade and rollback
requirements.notes: No down-migration. Privacy-weaker writer refused. Legacy files retained.

requirements.title: Product telemetry separation
requirements.notes: Existing opt-in channel stays outside the evidence store. Disable overrides stay.

requirements.title: Documentation operability
requirements.notes: Public docs that conflict with source were inventoried and are not rewritten here.

requirements.title: Support and security operations
requirements.notes: Not specified beyond threat cases and gates.

requirements.title: Independent customer acceptance
requirements.notes: Tier is defined and assigned to no requirement as achieved. Customer validation stays UNSET.

evidence_note: evidence_tier_now and customer_validation_now stay UNSET. required_evidence_tier_before_external_claim is the tier a later claim would need. It is not an achieved tier.
